children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Preserve a trustworthy change history, inspect system health, route notifications, and manage instance-wide settings without losing operational evidence.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Export incident evidence before changing filters, restarting components, or rotating the credentials involved.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Mutation and denied-access records connect actor, method, resource, status, and time in a tamper-evident chain.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Re-check chain integrity before relying on an exported audit window.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Filter by actor, method, status, and resource; retain denied events.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Export CSV with the incident timezone and scope recorded.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Use fleet metrics for symptoms, Kubernetes events for control-plane causes, and API/operator logs for service diagnostics.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Keep API and operator streams separate when following live logs.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Use structured level filters and download raw evidence for correlation.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Telemetry is on by default for new installs (v0.4.0); each tier can be turned off in Admin Settings.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Configure event sinks, instance identity, external URL, update channel, and build information as shared operational contracts.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Record cluster, namespace, resource UID, time range, and actor

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Export audit records, events, API/operator logs, and backup status

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Test notification delivery and preserve version/build information
